reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet that is made to go is solving a problem I don't have. I'd rather wait for a coupon on what I already buy.
objection: I take it at home on my counter and half the time I forget anyway, so carrying it around doesn't change anything for me, and $29.99 is more than I pay now.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about $15 for the month, or a flash sale deal that beats what I pay per day now.
